# Thura — Woven Open Source Collaboration Suite
> Built on top of Lidza Framework (Go control plane + Rust compute core + Astro frontend)

## Monorepo Layout
- Go Control Plane & AI Router: /pkg (ai, mail, drive, cal, meet)
- Rust Compute Crates: /crates (thura_crypto, thura_media, thura_ai)
- Līdza Packs: /packs (pack-ai, pack-mail, pack-drive, pack-calendar, pack-meetings)
- Astro Frontend: /apps/web
